description: Starts a Reputation Agent scan, a personal reputation check of the account holder, a brand reputation check of the account's own company, or both: Google results, answers from the main AI assistants (what ChatGPT and others say), reviews, news, social accounts and profiles, with AI visibility and the sources AI answers cite. Needs who it is for and the name with identifiers (a person: at least one of role, organization, place or an own link; the company: its website domain, verified under Brands, plus category, best known for and up to 3 competitors); the answer asks only for what is missing and returns a run id. Usually ready within 15 minutes. Use this when the person wants to see how Google and AI assistants describe them or their company, or what ChatGPT says about them. Do not use for anyone else (another person, a competitor, a client). Side effects: starts a scan on the public web; with paid: true, buys a rescan from the existing balance.

company.description: The own company: name and domain, plus category, best known for and up to 3 competitors. Example: {"name": "Northwind Studio", "domain": "northwind.example", "category": "Design agency"}

best_known_for.description: What it is best known for, for example "boutique hotels in Lisbon"

category.description: The category in a few words, for example "logistics software"

competitors.description: Up to 3 competitors, name and domain

domain.description: The company's website domain, for example example.com

for.description: Who the scan is for: person (me), brand (my company) or founder (both); asked once. Example: "founder"

idempotency_key.description: With paid: a unique key, reused only to retry the same purchase. Example: "rescan-2026-10-19"

link.description: One link that is the person's own. Example: "https://northwind.example/about"

name.description: The account holder's full name. Example: "Dana Example"

paid.description: true only when the included rescan is used and the person said yes, in this conversation, to a paid rescan at the price start_radar showed; never set it on your own. Example: true

role.description: Role or profession. Example: "Founder and CEO"

name: start_radar
title: Start the scan
